security_audit.summary: AI review confirmed the elevated OS package installation guidance in SKILL.md as a real security concern. The remaining static findings are false positives from bundled CSV reference data, markdown examples, docs URLs, and Python formatting helpers; no prompt injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md tells agents to install Python with sudo on Ubuntu or Debian.
remediation.suggestion: Change the prerequisite section to ask the user for explicit approval before any package-manager command, or direct users to install Python manually.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md includes Windows PowerShell package installation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Make Windows installation instructions informational only and require explicit user confirmation before running winget or PowerShell commands.

remediation.issue: Large CSV files contain many code examples and URLs that trigger static scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Document that CSV rows are inert reference data and keep examples clearly separated from executable helper scripts.

content.user_title: Design UI Systems With UX Guidance
content.value_statement: Design teams often need fast UI direction that matches their stack and product type. This skill searches bundled guidance to produce design systems, UX checks, and implementation advice.
actual_capabilities: Searches bundled UI, UX, typography, color, chart, icon, and product guidance.
Generates design system recommendations with style, palette, typography, and effects.
Provides stack-specific guidance for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui.
Reviews common accessibility, responsive layout, interaction, animation, and visual quality issues.
Suggests chart types and data presentation patterns for common dashboard needs.
Formats recommendations for terminal use or documentation workflows.
limitations: Guidance comes from bundled CSV files and may not reflect the newest framework releases.
The local search helper requires Python when command-line lookup is used.
It does not replace user testing, visual QA, or accessibility audits with assistive technology.
It provides recommendations, not guaranteed production-ready implementation code.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Interface
use_cases.description: Select a visual direction, palette, typography, and page structure before building a new screen.

use_cases.title: Review Frontend UI Quality
use_cases.description: Check a page for spacing, contrast, responsive behavior, hover states, and accessibility issues.

use_cases.title: Align a Prototype With a Stack
use_cases.description: Translate product goals into framework-specific patterns for React, Next.js, Vue, mobile, or component libraries.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Visual Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a landing page for [product] in [industry]. Recommend style, color palette, typography, layout sections, and accessibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review a UI Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this UI concept for [audience] on [stack]. Identify visual hierarchy, spacing, color, mobile, interaction, and accessibility issues.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Design System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a design system for [project]. Include product pattern, style rationale, typography, colors, components, chart guidance, and anti-patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use stack guidance for [framework] to improve this interface. Prioritize accessibility, responsive layout, performance, component patterns, and delivery checks.

output_examples.input: A healthcare SaaS dashboard needs a trustworthy design direction.
output_examples.output: Recommends a calm professional style, accessible blue and green palette, clear data hierarchy, Inter-based typography, and dashboard chart patterns.

output_examples.input: A mobile shopping app feels crowded and hard to scan.
output_examples.output: Flags spacing, touch target, card hierarchy, image ratio, and navigation issues, then suggests focused improvements for repeated browsing.

output_examples.input: A team wants stack-specific guidance for a Next.js marketing page.
output_examples.output: Provides page structure, image and font guidance, route and metadata recommendations, accessibility checks, and responsive layout notes.

best_practices: Start with product type, audience, industry, and target stack before asking for UI recommendations.
Use the design system output first, then request focused searches for typography, color, charts, or accessibility.
Validate recommendations with real content, responsive previews, contrast checks, and keyboard navigation tests.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic beautiful design without product context, audience, or stack details.
Do not treat framework examples as security, performance, or accessibility guarantees.
Do not skip manual review for contrast, focus order, mobile layout, and interaction states.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan, review, and improve UI and UX using bundled guidance for design systems, stacks, accessibility, and visual quality.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation, but its main value is structured design direction and review criteria.

faq.question: Which stacks does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for HTML and Tailwind, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, and shadcn/ui.

faq.question: Does it use live internet data?
faq.answer: No. The core guidance is bundled in local CSV files, so framework details may need separate verification.

faq.question: Is Python required?
faq.answer: Python is required only when using the local command-line search helper included with the skill.

faq.question: Can it replace accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest accessibility checks, but teams should still test with tools, keyboards, and assistive technology.
